footnotes: Figures are from the company's Form 20-F for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 7.7% to $2.9B in 2025. Gross margin was 66.4%, versus 66.7% a year earlier, and operating income rose 18.3% to $646M, a 21.9% margin.
Net income rose 39.3% to $612M, or $9.67 per share. Operating cash flow was $717M and free cash flow $698M, versus $798M; NICE returned $489M through buybacks.
sources: NICE Ltd. Form 20-F for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
